title: Correspondence with Whitley Strieber on the UFO phenomenon

tellings.quote: and conversations I had with Whitley Strieber who had contacted me years earlier uh for something kind of unrelated.

plain: The author Peter Levenda says that his thinking on UFOs was shaped in part by conversations with the writer Whitley Strieber, who had first contacted him years earlier about something unrelated. Levenda tells Michels this himself, as background to his book Sinister Forces, where those exchanges helped form his view of the phenomenon.
